The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 01271 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 27 September - the folder's feast day. Captioned Kallistrat and filed under Category:Callistratus of Carthage, the soldier-martyr of Carthaginian descent who suffered with his company under Diocletian - this folder's saint and his 49 companions.
